title: Maximum Product of Two Elements in an Array
summary: Given an array of integers, select two distinct indices.
statement: Given an array of integers, select two distinct indices. Calculate and return the highest product derived from multiplying the decremented values of the selected elements by one less than each.
constraints: Choose two distinct indices and maximize (nums[i]-1)*(nums[j]-1).
hints: Only the two largest values can maximize the product of nonnegative decremented values.
Track largest and second-largest in one scan.
Update both when a new maximum arrives, otherwise update the runner-up.
Monotonicity of multiplication on nonnegative operands proves no smaller pair can improve the result.
editorial: Monotonicity of multiplication on nonnegative operands proves no smaller pair can improve the result.

tests.explanation: Using five and four gives four times three, or twelve.
